answer: Each participant locks 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each audited by three randomly drawn reviewers with no shared funder and no prior co-review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays visible, so an ember of early activity is ignored until tenure matures, an umber stain of repeated evidence exposes copied records, and a jade seal binds each submission to its true issuer. Every extra identity needs its own bond, five jobs, and independent reviewers, so farming stays unprofitable.
